ENGLISH GLOSSES TO TRANSLATE:
  Terse gloss: "Lamp; a literal oil lamp (especially of the tabernacle/temple) or a figurative lamp symbolizing life, dynasty, or divine guidance."
  Readable gloss: "In its most concrete sense, this noun denotes the oil lamps that burned in Israel's sacred spaces -- the tabernacle lampstand (Exod 25:37) and the temple (1 Kgs 7:49). Spanish uniformly renders 'lampara,' French 'lampe,' and German 'Lampe,' all preserving the physical referent. Yet the word carries a rich figurative life in poetry and wisdom: the lamp of YHWH searching the human spirit (Prov 20:27), the lamp of the wicked being snuffed out (Job 18:6; 21:17), and David called 'the lamp of Israel' whose extinction would mean national ruin (2 Sam 21:17). The promise that David's dynasty will always have a lamp (1 Kgs 11:36; 15:4) weaves physical light into covenantal hope."

SENSES:
  Sense 1: "physical lamp or lamps"
    Enriched: A literal oil lamp or set of lamps, particularly the golden lamps of the tabernacle lampstand (Exod 25:37; 30:7-8) and temple furnishings (1 Kgs 7:49; 2 Chr 4:20). Translations across Spanish ('lamparas'), French ('lampe'), and German all preserve the concrete artifact sense. Also used of Zechariah's visionary lampstand (Zech 4:2) and household lamps (Prov 31:18).
    Existing Spanish translations: las-lámparas, lámparas, lámparas-de-él, sus-lámparas, y-lámparas-de-ella, y-lámparas-de-ellos, y-lámparas-sus, y-sus-lámparas
  Sense 2: "lamp as metaphor for life or guidance"
    Enriched: Lamp used metaphorically for life-force, prosperity, dynastic continuity, or divine guidance. David is 'the lamp of Israel' (2 Sam 21:17); God lights the psalmist's lamp (2 Sam 22:29 / Ps 18:28); the lamp of the wicked is extinguished (Job 18:6; Prov 24:20). French and German renderings remain 'lampe,' but Hebrew context shifts entirely from artifact to symbol of vitality and covenant promise.
    Existing Spanish translations: Lámpara, Lámpara-de, Y-lámpara-de, la-lámpara-de, la-lámpara-de-, lámpara, lámpara-de, lámpara-mía, mi-lámpara, su-lámpara, y-lámpara-de, y-su-lámpara
